fixed.impact: Nylzo applies web/patches/deepmerge@4.3.1.patch to its build dependency. It excludes __proto__ from both source and target keys, including recursive clones. Installation and SCA verify the exact patch, every lockfile reference, all three patched source hashes, prototype-poisoning regressions and Svelte option semantics. The unpatched npm package remains affected; this statement applies only to this Nylzo source revision. Replace the patch with an upstream fix when available.

notAffected.impact: The advisory concerns the deprecated OpenPGP packages. None of Nylzo's six supported build targets imports or links those packages. Other packages from golang.org/x/crypto remain in use. This assessment does not apply to a build that adds OpenPGP.
